title: Chocolate Cake
description: A moist two-layer chocolate cake made with dark chocolate, cacao, and sour cream.

steps.action: Butter and line two 9-in. round cake pans

steps.text: Chop the chocolate and put it in a bowl with the cacao powder.
Bring the water to a boil.
Pour the boiling water over the chocolate and whisk until smooth. Let it cool.
Sift the two flours, the baking soda, and the salt together.
Beat the butter with a mixer until it is creamy.
Add the brown sugar and beat until light and fluffy.

steps.action: beat in 1 egg at a time
steps.text: Beat in the eggs, one at a time.

steps.action: beat on medium speed for 10 sec. and scrape
steps.text: Add the sour cream and vanilla. Beat on medium speed for 10 seconds, then scrape the bowl.

steps.action: mix in flour and chocolate on low speed until just combined
steps.text: On low speed, add the flour and the chocolate in turns: 1/3 of the flour, 1/2 of the chocolate, 1/3 of the flour, the rest of the chocolate, then the rest of the flour. Stop when they are just mixed.
Divide the batter evenly between the two pans.

steps.action: smooth batter to edges of pans
steps.text: Spread the batter to the edges of the pans.
Bake for 25 minutes, until a toothpick in the center comes out clean.

steps.action: cool 5 min., turn out, cool completely
steps.text: Let the cakes cool in the pans for 5 minutes. Run a knife around the edges, turn the cakes out onto a wire rack, and let them cool fully.
Put one layer on a plate and spread frosting on top. Put the second layer on top, then frost the top and sides.
